pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.1: Tena samayena buddho bhagavā Sāvatthiyaṃ viharati Jetavane Anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.2: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ aññataraṃ kulaṃ ubhatopasannaṃ hoti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.3: saddhāya vaḍḍhati, bhogena hāyati, yaṃ tasmiṃ kule uppajjati purebhattaṃ khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā, taṃ sabbaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ vissajjetvā appekadā anasitā acchanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.5: kathaṃ hi nāma samaṇā Sakyaputtiyā na mattaṃ jānitvā paṭiggahessanti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.6: ime imesaṃ datvā appekadā anasitā acchantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.7: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.8: atha kho te bhikkhū bhagavato . . . ārocesuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.9: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne etasmiṃ pakaraṇe dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.10: anujānāmi bhikkhave yaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati evarūpassa kulassa ñattidutiyena kammena sekhasammutiṃ dātuṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.14: itthannāmaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.15: yadi saṃghassa pattakallaṃ, saṃgho itthannāmassa kulassa sekhasammutiṃ dadeyya.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.20: yassāyasmato khamati itthannāmassa kulassa sekhasammutiyā dānaṃ so tuṇh' assa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.24: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.25.1: yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulāni yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekhasammatesu kulesu khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.26: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesaniyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:1.27: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||1||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.1: tena kho pana samayena Sāvatthiyaṃ ussavo hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.3: taṃ pi kho kulaṃ bhikkhū nimantesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.5: paṭikkhittaṃ bhagavatā sekhasammatesu kulesu khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjitun ti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.7: kiṃ nu kho nāma amhākaṃ jīvitena yaṃ ayyā amhākaṃ na paṭigaṇhantīti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.8: assosuṃ kho bhikkhū tesaṃ manussānaṃ . . . vipācentānaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.10: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.11: anujānāmi bhikkhave nimantitena sekhasammatesu kulesu khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.12: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.13.1: yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulāni yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekhasammatesu kulesu pubbe animantito khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ . . .
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:2.15: evañ c' idaṃ bhagavatā bhikkhūnaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ paññattaṃ hoti. ||2||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.1: tena kho pana samayena aññataro bhikkhu tassa kulassa kulūpako hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.2: atha kho so bhikkhu pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaraṃ ādāya yena taṃ kulaṃ ten' upasaṃkami, upasaṃkamitvā paññatte āsane nisīdi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.3: tena kho pana samayena so bhikkhu gilāno hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.4: atha kho te manussā taṃ bhikkhuṃ etad avocuṃ:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.7: bhagavatā paṭikkhittaṃ animantitena sekhasammatesu kulesu khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjitun ti kukkuccāyanto na paṭiggahesi,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.10: atha kho so bhikkhu ārāmaṃ gantvā bhikkhūnaṃ etam atthaṃ ārocesi.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.12: atha kho bhagavā etasmiṃ nidāne dhammiṃ kathaṃ katvā bhikkhū āmantesi:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.13: anujānāmi bhikkhave gilānena bhikkhunā sekhasammatesu kulesu khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādituṃ bhuñjituṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.14: evañ ca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha:
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.15.1: yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulāni yo pana bhikkhu tathārūpesu sekhasammatesu kulesu pubbe animantito agilāno khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādeyya vā bhuñjeyya vā, paṭidesetabbaṃ tena bhikkhunā
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:3.16: gārayhaṃ āvuso dhammaṃ āpajjiṃ asappāyaṃ pāṭidesaniyaṃ, taṃ paṭidesemīti. ||3||
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.1: yāni kho pana tāni sekhasammatāni kulānīti,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.2: sekhasammataṃ nāma kulaṃ yaṃ kulaṃ saddhāya vaḍḍhati bhogena hāyati, evarūpassa kulassa ñattidutiyena kammena sekhasammuti dinnā hoti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.10: ajjatanāya vā svātanāya vā animantito. gharūpacāraṃ okkamante nimanteti, eso animantito nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.12: ajjatanāya vā svātanāya vā nimantito. gharūpacāraṃ anokkamante nimanteti, eso nimantito nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.18: pañca bhojanāni yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ ṭhapetvā avasesaṃ khādaniyaṃ nāma.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.20: pañca bhojanāni odano kummāso sattu maccho maṃsaṃ.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.1.21: animantito agilāno khādissāmi bhuñjissāmīti paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.2.1: sekhasammate sekhasammatasaññī animantito agilāno khādaniyaṃ vā bhojaniyaṃ vā sahatthā paṭiggahetvā khādati vā bhuñjati vā, āpatti pāṭidesaniyassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.2.4: yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ āhāratthāya paṭigaṇhāti, āpatti dukkaṭassa.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.3.4: nimantitassa vā gilānassa vā sesakaṃ bhuñjati,
pli-tv-bu-vb-pd3:4.3.12: yāmakālikaṃ sattāhakālikaṃ yāvajīvikaṃ sati paccaye paribhuñjati deti,
